purpose: Teach: 前列/鮓/峪/壱/魏/起る/不確か/組成

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、講演会場の前列、つまり前列の不審者を、警察、警戒されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police will be vigilant about the suspicious person in the front row of the lecture hall, won't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Soft opening on 「本件」. Curiosity paced evenly, not rushed. Voice rises slightly at the end—a genuine question seeking confirmation, not a rhetorical flourish.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の古い鮓、つまり鮓の容器の鑑定もされますね
lines.en: The police will also be authenticating the old sushi container from the seized items, won't they?
lines.style: Agreeing nod in the voice. Steady, professional tone. Slight emphasis on the practical detail—acknowledging the thoroughness without fanfare. Collaborative inflection at the clause break.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、山の峪、つまり峪の遭難事案を、警察、捜索されますね
lines.en: In this case, for the missing person incident in the mountain valley, the police will conduct a search, won't they?
lines.style: Careful, deliberate pacing. Slight pause before 「山の峪」—letting the detail settle. Quiet conviction underneath. Voice stays level, grounded in the procedural reality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧字「壱」、つまり「一」の偽造文書も鑑定されますね
lines.en: The police will also authenticate the forged documents with the old character for 'one,' won't they?
lines.style: Steady, procedural. Light emphasis on the forensic distinction between the characters. Calm authority—not lecturing, just laying out what needs doing. Closes firmly but not harshly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、押収古文書の魏王朝印の鑑定を、警察、専門家に依頼されますね
lines.en: In this case, for the authentication of the Wei Dynasty seal on the confiscated historical documents, the police will consult with experts, won't they?
lines.style: Respectful tone when naming the historical artifact. Measured pacing. Slight lift at 「専門家に依頼」—acknowledging the specialized knowledge required. Ends with genuine question inflection.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、事件が起る、つまり起こる前に未然防止策をされますね
lines.en: The police will take preventive measures before an incident even occurs, won't they?
lines.style: Calm, almost philosophical. Long, even breath before the preventive concept. Professional warmth—no edge, just steady conviction that this matters. Ends with gentle affirmation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の供述に不確かな部分を、警察、慎重に確認されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police will carefully verify any uncertain portions of the victim's statement, won't they?
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. Weight on 「慎重に」—this is where careful matters. Quiet intensity underneath. Not accusatory, just rigorous. Slight trailing-off on the question tag.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、爆発物の組成分析を、警察、慎重におこなわれますね
lines.en: The police will conduct a careful compositional analysis of the explosive material, won't they?
lines.style: Professional, close to neutral. Slight drop in volume on the technical detail. Steady, unrushed. No emotion attached to the procedure itself—just the competent statement of what must be done.
